EXACT_CANDIDATES_SCORED_DEFINITION: pool tickets scored by exact residual marginal (admissible universe plus required tickets) plus complete quintuples evaluated exactly at solver leaves
NOT_CLAIMED: optimality beyond the sampled destroy quintuples and their candidate pools
superiority or equality relative to protected Lane 3

CHECKS: exact solver vs brute force, bound on and off

PEAK_MEMORY_DEFINITION: ru_maxrss of the single pilot process (one worker, no children)

POOL_SOURCE_DEFINITIONS.CAP_RULE: required tickets first; remaining capacity by highest exact residual marginal against R, ties to the lowest ticket; pool cap 48 is a heuristic
POOL_SOURCE_DEFINITIONS.ELITE: tickets of the pinned elites V5, V6 and CYCLE that are not frozen in R (always in the pool)
POOL_SOURCE_DEFINITIONS.MUTATION_L1: legal one-number mutations of the removed tickets, ranked by exact residual marginal
POOL_SOURCE_DEFINITIONS.MUTATION_L2: one-number mutations of each removed ticket's three best level-1 mutations (bounded two-number neighbourhood), ranked by exact residual marginal
POOL_SOURCE_DEFINITIONS.REMOVED: the five removed tickets (always in the pool)

SOLVER_DETAIL: DFS over pool tickets in descending single-marginal order; pruning only by the submodular remaining-slot bound (covered + sum of the r largest exact marginals); the last two slots are solved exactly by a weighted Gram matrix; strict-improvement incumbent starting at the removed tickets; no heuristic prunes
TIE_BREAK: max exact count, then lowest normalized portfolio sha256
